name: Teen Arts Group (TAG)
what_you_do: Learn how an art museum works, from planning shows to caring for art. Lead tours, post on social media, plan Teen Night Out and other events, and make your own art.
who_can_apply: High school-aged youth who care about leadership, community and art. The page does not list other rules.
pay_detail: Members receive community-service learning credits or a stipend for taking part. The page does not give the stipend amount.
deadline_text: The page says the application deadline is typically in May. No 2027 date is posted.
how_to_apply: Apply through the TAG page when the application opens in spring. The process includes a virtual interview.
notes: The page gives only a typical month (May), so watch the page in spring. Questions: teenprograms@seattleartmuseum.org. SAM's other internships are for college students and early-career adults, not high schoolers. If you take the stipend, ask whether you need Washington parent and school papers for a minor.
